fullPassage: Triboulet was born in France in the 15th century. His body looked different from those of other people. He had short, crooked legs and long arms. People teased him about how he looked, but Triboulet just made it part of his sense of humor. He was so funny that it was his job to make the king laugh. But Triboulet was not just funny. He was also very bold. One day, Triboulet found himself in serious trouble. He had decided to slap the backside of the king. The king didn't consider it funny and demanded an apology. Triboulet apologized by saying, "I'm sorry. I didn't recognize you! I thought you were the queen!" The king found this even less amusing. He decided to put him to death. He allowed Triboulet to choose how he would die. Triboulet immediately replied, "I choose to die of old age." The king liked this clever answer, so he called off the execution.

① (A) ~라고 여기다 (B) ~을 찾다: found this less amusing=이것을 덜 재밌다고 여기다, found his dog=개를 찾다 ←정답
② (A) ~을 찾다 (B) ~라고 여기다: (A)에서 농담을 '찾다'? 부적절
③ (A) ~라고 여기다 (B) ~을 설립하다: (B)에서 개를 '설립하다'? 부적절
④ (A) ~을 발견하다 (B) ~라고 여기다: 두 문맥 모두 반대
det.tip: find의 다의어: find + 목적어 + 형용사=~라고 여기다 vs find=찾다/발견하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "brave and willing to take risks or do something that others are afraid to do"

det.korean: cruel=잔인한 / gentle=온화한 / careful=조심스러운 / bold=대담한
det.analysis:
① cruel: 잔인한 — 용감함과 무관
② gentle: 온화한 — 위험을 감수하는 것과 반대
③ careful: 조심스러운 — 위험을 감수하는 것과 반대
④ bold: 대담한 — 용감하고 위험을 감수하는 성질 ←정답
det.tip: brave and willing to take risks(용감하고 위험을 감수하는) = bold(대담한)

questions.passage: The king demanded an apology. Triboulet apologized by __________ (say), "I'm sorry. I didn't recognize you!"
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: say(동사: 말하다) → saying(동명사). 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: say를 동명사 saying으로 변환. 'apologized by saying'=말함으로써 사과했다 — 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함
det.tip: 전치사(by) + 동명사(-ing). by saying=말함으로써

questions.passage: He decided to put him to death. He allowed Triboulet __________ (choose) how he would die.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: choose(동사: 선택하다) → to choose. allow + 목적어 + to부정사 구문
det.analysis: choose를 to choose로 변환. 'allow + 목적어(Triboulet) + to부정사' 구문이므로 to choose가 필요 — '~가 …하도록 허락하다'
det.tip: allow + O + to V = ~가 V하도록 허락하다 → to choose

questions.passage: Triboulet was born in France in the 15th century. His body looked different from those of other people. He had short, crooked legs and long arms. People teased him about how he looked, but Triboulet just made it part of his __________. He was so funny that it was his job to make the king laugh. But Triboulet was not just funny. He was also very bold. One day, Triboulet found himself in serious trouble. He had decided to slap the backside of the king. The king didn't consider it funny and demanded an apology. Triboulet apologized by saying, "I'm sorry. I didn't recognize you! I thought you were the queen!" The king found this even less amusing. He decided to put him to death. He allowed Triboulet to choose how he would die. Triboulet immediately replied, "I choose to die of old age." The king liked this clever answer, so he called off the execution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fear of death=죽음의 공포 / sense of humor=유머 감각 / loss of pride=자존심 상실 / way of life=삶의 방식
det.analysis:
① fear of death: 죽음의 공포? 놀림을 웃음으로 바꾼 문맥과 무관
② sense of humor: 놀림을 자신의 유머 감각의 일부로 만들었다 ←정답
③ loss of pride: 자존심 상실? 오히려 유쾌하게 넘김
④ way of life: 삶의 방식? 놀림 대처와 직접 연결 약함
det.tip: 놀림받았지만 웃음거리로 승화 → 그의 sense of humor(유머 감각)의 일부로

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: set him free=그를 풀어주다 / make him laugh=그를 웃기다 / put him to death=그를 처형하다 / send him home=그를 집에 보내다
det.analysis:
① set him free: 화가 난 왕이 그를 풀어준다? 뒤 문맥과 모순
② make him laugh: 그를 웃긴다? 처벌 문맥과 안 맞음
③ put him to death: 무례함에 화가 난 왕이 그를 처형하기로 결정했다 ←정답
④ send him home: 집에 보낸다? 처벌 문맥과 안 맞음
det.tip: 뒤에 execution(처형), die(죽다) 언급 → 왕이 그를 처형하기로(put him to death) 결정
